agent_explanation: Elastic bounce with e=1 and semi-implicit Euler substeps injects energy. Body falls under gravity, hits floor between steps 55-56, and rebounds with higher speed (12.36 -> 14.19 m/s) causing total mechanical energy to jump from ~83.86 J to 108.99 J, exceeding initial energy 84.05 J + tolerance (allow 97.45 J). Positional correction plus restitution impulse appears to over-add velocity, violating energy conservation for e=1. Reducing restitution to <1 makes dissipation mask the gain.
